description: Splits a team's roster by published NTRP level and gives each level group's players, wins, losses and win rate this season, over every league line those players appeared in. Call it for a roster's shape rather than its results, as in 'how strong is their 4.0 half' or 'who carries this team'. It works even before a season has been played, because it then reads the season before.

asked.description: The person's question word for word, never paraphrased. Leave it out rather than invent one.

phase.description: Optional competition phase: 'sectionals', 'playoffs', 'postseason', or 'regular season'. Pass it when the member names one, or when they ask how a level group did in their LEAGUE — a sectional match keeps its REGULAR-SEASON league name in our data, so there is no other way to separate them. Omit to count every phase.

team.description: Team key or display name. Or the team's Desk page link or number.
